headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 24, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 23.63% compared to SPY's 12.77%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 10.86%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 45.48%, significantly contributing to the overall portfolio strength. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 9.30%, highlighting the variance in performance among the portfolios. Such relative performance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress or uncertainty, as it reflects the portfolio's resilience against broader market movements. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
